1.

Come, let us in childlike wise Raise the praise of the Lord Jesus! But say, who is sufficient for this? Alas, no words here suffice.

C.

Praise and honour we sing To the Lord Jesus, who has redeemed us, Hosanna, Hosanna, Hosanna we sing to the Lamb of God. Praise and honour we sing To the Lord Jesus, who has redeemed us, Hosanna, Hosanna, Hosanna we sing to the Lamb of God.

2.

Behold Jesus, crowned in heaven’s height! Extol His majesty with joy! He is the King of kings And bears the crown of glory.
